search_protocol.selection: Purposeful triangulation of full-text methods, empirical meta-research, reporting guidelines, regulatory standards, official policies, and abstract-level boundary evidence. Inclusion supports only named contract decisions.

generalization_rule: Enforce cross-domain identity, provenance, unit, disclosure, and cross-surface contradictions only when recorded facts support them. Never infer model adequacy, causal validity, power, generalization, scientific truth, or acceptance from reporting completeness or a passing contract.
